info.name: Science Street Lab API
info.description:
REST API collection for Science Street Lab (Laravel `/api/v1`).

**Auth:** Laravel Sanctum Bearer token.
Login/Register requests auto-save `token` into collection variables.

**Base URL:** set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:8000`).

Seeded example values (after `php artisan db:seed`):
- Product: `science-street-microscope`
- Course: `microscope-course`
- Competition: `microscope-100-challenge`
- Page: `about`
- Blog: `welcome-to-science-street`
- Coupon: `SCIENCE10`
- Admin: `admin@sciencestreetlab.com` / `password`
